findings.title: Possible type mismatch for ranges field
findings.message: The gallery state is stored in `m.ranges`, but that field is declared as `*macRangeGallery`. The code checks `m.ranges == nil`, then builds `p := &macRangeGallery{...}`. However, the type of `m.ranges` in the diff is not `[]*ui.RangeSlider`, which is what the first line of the function body needs. Later, `for _, r := range p.ranges` uses `p`, which is correct. The `m.ranges == nil` check and the assignment are consistent with the struct field, so the compile problem is limited to the composite literal `[]*ui.RangeSlider{{ID: ...}}`. That literal is valid for pointer elements, so this finding has low confidence.
findings.suggestion: Confirm that the package builds, and that the `ranges` field type matches the way it is used.
